{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Identify and remove sentinel values (negative ages)
sentinel_mask = (sales_df['customer_age'] < 0)
valid_df = sales_df[~sentinel_mask]

# Compute mean age on valid data
mean_age_valid = valid_df['customer_age'].mean()

mean_age_valid"}
